text: The earlier promise made Isaac the child of the covenant, the one through whom the nations are to be blessed, and God now turns that promise into a test. Abraham answers with one word. He says _hineni_, "here I am," three times in the course of the scene, first to God, then to Isaac, and last to the angel; and the word does not mean the same thing on any two occasions, for each answer costs him more than the one before. The third is spoken to the angel.
